name: Mobile BFF - Onboarding Service API
description:
Backend for Frontend (BFF) service for mobile onboarding journey.

**Architecture:** Clean/Hexagonal, Reactive (WebFlux)

**Security:** OAuth2/JWT, Zero-Trust

**Compliance:** SAMA KYC/AML, Data Residency

This API provides mobile-optimized endpoints for customer onboarding including:
- Content retrieval (T&C, Privacy Policy, Contracts)
- Identity verification (Nationality, OTP, Nafath)
- Personal information collection
- Tax compliance (FATCA/CRS)
- Card selection and personalization
- Contract signing
